exposure: postdates induction of labour with oxytocin under midwifery care
postdates induction of labour with oxytocin under obstetrical care
cohort: low-risk Ontario midwifery clients who had postdates oxytocin induction
finding: For low-risk midwifery clients at 41 weeks or more gestation, induction of labor with oxytocin under midwifery care had similar odds of Cesarean section and neonatal morbidity and mortality compared to induction under obstetrical care, but decreased rates of intervention.
mod_finding: For low-risk midwifery clients at 41 weeks or more gestation, the odds of Caesarean section and neonatal morbidity and mortality are similar when induction of labour with oxytocin under the care of a midwife is compared with induction of labour under obstetrical care, and rates of intervention are decreased.
